# Forage United States

> A free guide to wild food in the United States: which wild plants are in season in each state and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 86 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/)

- [Butternut](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/butternut/): Juglans cinerea; Butternut, White walnut. In season September to October.
- [Chinquapin](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/chinquapin/): Castanea pumila; Chinquapin, Allegheny chinquapin. In season September to October.
- [Desert chia](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/chia/): Salvia columbariae; Desert chia, Golden chia. In season May to July.
- [Palo verde beans](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/paloverde/): Parkinsonia microphylla; Palo verde beans. In season May to June.
- [Sassafras](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/sassafras/): Sassafras albidum; Sassafras, Filé. In season May to September.
- [Spicebush](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/spicebush/): Lindera benzoin; Spicebush, Wild allspice. In season August to October.
- [Sweetfern](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/sweetfern/): Comptonia peregrina; Sweetfern. In season May to September.
- [Pineapple weed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/pineappleweed/): Matricaria discoidea; Pineapple weed, Wild chamomile. In season June to September.
- [Wild mint](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/wildmint/): Mentha canadensis; Wild mint, American wild mint. In season June to September.
- [Japanese honeysuckle flowers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/honeysuckle/): Lonicera japonica; Japanese honeysuckle flowers. In season May to July.
- [Clams](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/clam/): Mya arenaria / Leukoma staminea; Clams. In season September to May.
- [Oysters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/oyster/): Crassostrea virginica / Magallana gigas; Oysters. In season September to April.
- [Morel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/morel/): Morchella spp.; Morel. In season April to June.
- [Oyster mushroom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/oystermush/): Pleurotus ostreatus; Oyster mushroom. In season October to May.
- [Hen of the woods](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/henwoods/): Grifola frondosa; Hen of the woods, Maitake. In season September to October.
- [Lion's mane](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/lionsmane/): Hericium spp.; Lion's mane. In season August to November.
- [Black trumpet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/blacktrumpet/): Craterellus fallax / C. cornucopioides; Black trumpet, Horn of plenty. In season July to October.
- [Shaggy mane](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/shaggymane/): Coprinus comatus; Shaggy mane, Lawyer's wig. In season May to October.
- [Chaga](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/chaga/): Inonotus obliquus; Chaga. In season all year round.

## Dishes

- [Sumac lemonade](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/sumac-lemonade/): Rub sumac clusters in cold water for an hour, strain through a cloth and sweeten. Pink and tart.
- [Elderflower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Steep flower heads overnight with lemon, strain and dissolve in sugar syrup. Dilute with sparkling water.
- [Spruce tip soda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/spruce-tip-soda/): Spruce tip syrup topped with soda water and lime.
- [Prickly pear agua fresca](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/prickly-pear-agua-fresca/): Blend peeled tunas with water and lime, strain out the seeds and serve over ice.
- [Rose hip tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/rose-hip-tea/): Simmer dried hips, strained, with honey.
- [Maple sap tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/maple-sap-tea/): Fresh sap simmered with a tea bag, lightly sweet with no sugar added.
- [Chokecherry syrup soda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/chokecherry-syrup-soda/): Chokecherry syrup with sparkling water, a Plains favourite.
- [Nettle tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/nettle-tea/): Steep fresh or dried nettle leaves in hot water for 5–10 minutes.
- [Fiddlehead sauté](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/fiddlehead-saut/): Boiled fiddleheads sautéed in butter with garlic and lemon.
- [Pickled ramps](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/pickled-ramps/): Ramp bulbs in a hot spiced vinegar brine.
- [Black locust fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/black-locust-fritters/): Flower clusters dipped in light batter, fried and dusted with sugar.
- [Dandelion fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/dandelion-fritters/): Flower heads in batter, fried until golden, with honey.
- [Purslane salad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/purslane-salad/): Purslane with tomato, cucumber and lemon.
- [Verdolagas con huevo](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/verdolagas-con-huevo/): Purslane scrambled with egg, onion and chilli, Mexican style.
- [Nopales salad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/nopales-salad/): Diced, de-spined pads boiled and tossed with tomato, onion, coriander and lime.
- [Roasted pecans](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/roasted-pecans/): Pecans toasted with butter, salt and a little cayenne.
- [Wild garlic mustard pesto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-garlic-mustard-pesto/): Leaves blended with nuts, cheese, olive oil and lemon.
- [Ramp butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/ramp-butter/): Chopped ramp leaves beaten into softened butter.
- [Cranberry sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/cranberry-sauce/): Cranberries simmered with sugar and orange until they pop.
- [Elderberry syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/elderberry-syrup/): Berries simmered with honey, ginger and cinnamon, strained.
- [Wild grape jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-grape-jelly/): Juiced wild grapes set with sugar.
- [Crabapple jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/crabapple-jelly/): Crab apples simmered, strained and set into a pink jelly.
- [Kinpira gobo](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/kinpira-gobo/): Matchstick burdock root stir-fried with carrot, soy, mirin and sesame.
- [Nettle soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/nettle-soup/): Nettle tops simmered with potato and onion, blended with cream.
- [Lamb's quarters spanakopita](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/lamb-s-quarters-spanakopita/): Wild greens with feta in crisp filo.
- [Wild rice soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-rice-soup/): Creamy wild rice and mushroom soup, a Minnesota classic.
- [Crawfish étouffée](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/crawfish-touff-e/): Crawfish tails in a roux of butter, onion, celery and pepper over rice.
- [Camas and salmon bake](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/camas-and-salmon-bake/): Slow-baked camas bulbs alongside cedar-planked salmon, after Pacific Northwest tradition.
- [Roasted sunchokes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/roasted-sunchokes/): Sunchokes roasted crisp with olive oil, thyme and salt.
- [Acorn pancakes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/acorn-pancakes/): Leached acorn flour mixed half and half with wheat flour.
- [Mesquite cookies](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/mesquite-cookies/): Sweet mesquite flour shortbread with a caramel taste.
- [Black walnut bread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/black-walnut-bread/): Quick bread studded with black walnuts.
- [Blackberry cobbler](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/blackberry-cobbler/): Blackberries baked under a buttery biscuit topping.
- [Persimmon pudding](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/persimmon-pudding/): Spiced baked pudding of ripe persimmon pulp, a Midwestern and Southern tradition.
- [Pawpaw ice cream](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/pawpaw-ice-cream/): Pawpaw pulp churned into custard ice cream.
- [Huckleberry pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/huckleberry-pie/): Mountain huckleberries in a double-crust pie.
- [Serviceberry crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/serviceberry-crumble/): Serviceberries under an oat crumble.
- [Pecan pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/pecan-pie/): Pecans in a caramel custard filling.
- [Maple taffy on snow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/maple-taffy-on-snow/): Maple syrup boiled to soft-ball stage and poured on clean snow.
- [Mulberry galette](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/mulberry-galette/): Mulberries in a free-form buttery tart.
- [Manzanita cider](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/manzanita-cider/): Crushed ripe berries steeped in cold water and strained, a Californian Native drink.
- [Fireweed tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/fireweed-tea/): Fermented fireweed leaves brewed as tea.
- [Beach plum jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/beach-plum-jelly/): Cape Cod beach plums cooked and strained into jelly.
- [Mayhaw jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/mayhaw-jelly/): Louisiana and Georgia's spring jelly.
- [Ground cherry salsa](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/ground-cherry-salsa/): Ripe ground cherries with chilli, onion and lime.
- [Pickled bull kelp](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/pickled-bull-kelp/): Sliced kelp stipe rings in sweet dill brine.
- [Chanterelle and wild rice soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/chanterelle-and-wild-rice-soup/): Chanterelles and wild rice in a creamy soup.
- [Chicken of the woods tacos](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/chicken-of-the-woods-tacos/): Shredded, seared chicken of the woods in tortillas with salsa.
- [Puffball parmesan](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/puffball-parmesan/): Breaded puffball slices baked with tomato and cheese.
- [Porcini pasta](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/porcini-pasta/): Porcini sautéed with garlic, tossed with pasta and parmesan.
- [Muscadine hull pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/muscadine-hull-pie/): Southern pie of muscadine hulls and pulp.
- [Highbush cranberry pudding](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/highbush-cranberry-pudding/): Tart berry sauce over steamed pudding.
- [Wild strawberry shortcake](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-strawberry-shortcake/): Tiny wild strawberries over biscuits with whipped cream.
- [Pineapple weed tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/pineapple-weed-tea/): Fresh or dried flower heads steeped like chamomile, with honey.
- [Wild mint iced tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-mint-iced-tea/): Mint steeped strong, chilled and sweetened, with lemon.
- [Spicebush tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/spicebush-tea/): Twigs and leaves simmered into a citrusy, spicy tea.
- [Honeysuckle lemonade](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/honeysuckle-lemonade/): Honeysuckle flower syrup stirred into fresh lemonade.
- [Horchata de chufa](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/horchata-de-chufa/): Soaked tiger nuts blended with water, cinnamon and sugar, strained and chilled.
- [Chaga tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/chaga-tea/): Chaga chunks simmered for a few hours into a dark, earthy brew.
- [Chia fresca](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/chia-fresca/): Chia seeds soaked in water with lime and a little honey.
- [Fried morels](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/fried-morels/): Halved morels dredged in flour or cracker crumbs and fried in butter, a Midwest spring ritual.
- [Steamers with drawn butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/steamers-with-drawn-butter/): Soft-shell clams steamed open and dipped in broth then melted butter.
- [Oysters on the half shell](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/oysters-on-the-half-shell/): Freshly shucked oysters with lemon and mignonette.
- [Sochan greens](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/sochan-greens/): Young leaves boiled, then fried in bacon fat, the Cherokee way.
- [Beautyberry jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/beautyberry-jelly/): Beautyberries simmered and strained into a floral pink jelly.
- [Black cherry jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/black-cherry-jelly/): Black cherries cooked, strained of their stones and set into dark jelly.
- [Wild black currant jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-black-currant-jam/): Wild currants cooked with sugar into a tart, rich jam.
- [Buffaloberry jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/buffaloberry-jelly/): Frost-sweetened buffaloberries made into a tangy jelly.
- [Saguaro fruit syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/saguaro-fruit-syrup/): Saguaro pulp boiled down into a dark, fig-like syrup.
- [Sea grape jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/sea-grape-jelly/): Florida sea grapes cooked and strained into jelly.
- [Kudzu blossom jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/kudzu-blossom-jelly/): Grape-scented kudzu flowers steeped and set into purple jelly.
- [Loquat jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/loquat-jam/): Peeled, seeded loquats cooked into a golden jam.
- [Wild nori furikake](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-nori-furikake/): Toasted, crumbled wild nori mixed with sesame and salt.
- [New England clam chowder](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/new-england-clam-chowder/): Clams, potato, salt pork and cream.
- [Mussels in white wine](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/mussels-in-white-wine/): Mussels steamed with garlic, shallots and white wine.
- [Roasted hen of the woods](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/roasted-hen-of-the-woods/): Maitake clusters roasted until crisp at the edges.
- [Lion's mane crab cakes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/lion-s-mane-crab-cakes/): Shredded lion's mane in place of crab, pan-fried.
- [Morel cream pasta](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/morel-cream-pasta/): Morels sautéed in butter with shallot and cream over pasta.
- [Oyster mushroom po' boy](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/oyster-mushroom-po-boy/): Crispy fried oyster mushrooms in a po' boy roll.
- [Wood nettle pesto pasta](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wood-nettle-pesto-pasta/): Blanched wood nettle blended into pesto and tossed with pasta.
- [Gumbo with filé](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/gumbo-with-fil/): Chicken and sausage gumbo thickened at the table with filé powder.
- [Prairie turnip stew](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/prairie-turnip-stew/): Dried prairie turnips simmered with bison or beef, after Lakota tradition.
- [Balsam fir shortbread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/balsam-fir-shortbread/): Butter shortbread scented with ground fir tips.
- [Irish moss blancmange](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/irish-moss-blancmange/): Irish moss simmered in milk with vanilla and set, a Maine classic.
- [Dewberry cobbler](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/dewberry-cobbler/): Early dewberries under a buttery cobbler crust.
- [Wild apple pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-apple-pie/): Mixed feral apples in a double-crust pie with cinnamon.
